note: The tiers are added up from this player’s vehicles, since a skirmish is fought with vehicles of its own tier. The 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day figures by tier have been recorded since November 2026, so a window stays empty until that record covers it.
note-older-formats: Older formats are the battles fought on vehicles of other tiers, from the years when a skirmish capped the tier (up to VI, VIII or X) instead of fixing it.
